translations.name: Lawrence Transit Fare-Free Service
translations.description: Lawrence Transit offers fare-free fixed-route bus service in Lawrence. Anyone can ride the regular buses without applying. T Lift offers free rides to people with disabilities who cannot use regular bus routes. Riders must apply and qualify for T Lift. On Demand is a shared-ride service for evenings and Sundays that you book through an app or online for $3 each way.
translations.website_description: Find fare-free bus routes, schedules, and transit services in Lawrence.
